shadow_memory.premise: nothing inside the start-up band cells (outline grown by startup_reach_m)

encoder_model.name: team_spec_quantized
encoder_model.wheels: rear left, rear right (MT6701, driven wheels)
encoder_model.steering: each front steering joint read as a KTH7801-C 12-bit angle with an ideal internal zero at straight ahead (the truck has one steering encoder on an unknown linkage)
encoder_model.inl_shape: first harmonic of the shaft angle, typical amplitude, phase per sensor from the seed
encoder_model.sample: one reading per physics tick; row i is the rotation over (t[i-1], t[i]], row 0 is 0
